history.summary: A freehold 1,195 sqft 3BR at Global Ville (D12, Balestier/Mount Pleasant area), built 2000, at $2.0M / $1,674 psf. Freehold and a clean $2.0M quantum are positives, but the 4.8%/yr rate rests on only 11 txns and the listing is ~4% above the project median.
history.rating_rationale: Freehold tenure, a $2.0M quantum right in the liquid band, and a usable 1,195 sqft 3BR layout are the strengths. But the 4.8%/yr appreciation is built on only 11 URA transactions — thin and unreliable — and the listing PSF is ~3.6% above the project's $1,615 median. Built 2000, so a 26-year-old development with older facilities. The Mount Pleasant MRT (TEL) at 870m is a modest convenience but the walk is 11 min. A balanced profile that lands at Neutral.
red_flags: Built 2000 — ageing, dated facilities; 870m/11-min to MRT
catalysts: Mount Pleasant MRT (Thomson-East Coast Line) within ~870m
Clean $2.0M quantum in the liquid band
